scope: next skill run specification; implement v3 environment and collector before training

reward.coefficient_status: recommended starting values; user confirmed thresholds and signs, not these exact coefficients

success.target_radius_source: per-skill place.target_radius_m / upright.target_radius_m; no scene plate override

decision_status: User-confirmed task thresholds; numeric reward coefficients below are starting recommendations pending trajectory preflight
gripper_mapping: Pass through official pi05_libero native continuous action; no GAWM probability inversion
lr_schedule: 3 critic-only updates; actor linear warmup10 updates then constant
formal_update_scope: rank16 alpha16 LoRA on action-expert QKVO and gated FFN, plus full critic; frozen base
gpu_binding: CUDA UUID whitelist and EGL_CUDA_DEVICE_NV enumeration, not raw physical index
full_resume: weights/optimizer/RNG recovery required; unfinished environment trajectory recovery must be implemented or explicitly logged as discarded, never claimed bit-exact without verification
curriculum: same objects across multiple original scenes; retain all-scene variants rather than only the first scene per object; verify core white/yellow-white mugs and moka before broadening
batch_numerics: Preserve original 8-env sampling groups and order in PPO gradient microbatches; no mixed batch regrouping
clearance_reference: EEF to object center >=0.10m, plus released/open and actual support; approach shaping retains center+0.05m reference
demo_warmup: No unverified BC data. Previous v2 scripted recovery attempts yielded zero valid demonstrations. If exploration remains zero-success, report it; any proposed successful-demo warmup must be physically validated and recorded separately.
upright_eligible_types: all long movable types except book,plate,frying pan,cream cheese,butter,chocolate pudding,basket; flat items still trained for pick/place
no_progress_policy: run bounded 6h pilot, do not silently alter rewards/learning rates; nonfinite, logprob mismatch, excessive post-update KL stop and trigger bounded recovery

pick.height_progress_credit: new progress only; no repeated lift-drop reward farming
pick.horizontal_cost_measure: sum of per-native-step object XY travel, never refunded on return
pick.horizontal_failure_measure: object XY distance from initial policy-time object position
pick.descent_deadband_scope: single cumulative noise allowance per episode, not a fresh free decrease on every step; verify slow repeated descent is penalized

place.height_measurement: object clearance above target support, not EEF height; verify against collision geometry
place.target: local region beneath/near initial held object

upright.initial_state: naturally settled tilted or side-fallen object; reject trivial self-righted reset
upright.target: in place or nearby on valid support
